spatial_coverage.coverage: Small Huron Creek watershed in Houghton County, Michigan Upper Peninsula, roughly 7.25 km2 with a main channel about 5.15 km long. The region is retained as the executable USGS 3DEP benchmark area after seed replacement because the replacement seed's Portuguese UAV-lidar survey is not available through the US-only catalog Anchor.

analytical_capabilities: Metre-scale bare-earth elevation and micro-topographic structure analysis
Slope, aspect, curvature, relief and terrace-geometry derivation

unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the `elevation` band in metres. Mosaic only tiles from a documented acquisition project, inspect seams, and verify coverage before analysis. Any coarser experimental grid must be derived from the qualifying one-metre source.

current_task_binding.data_source: USGS 3D Elevation Program, produced exclusively from high-resolution airborne lidar
current_task_binding.region_scope_provenance: Executable region retained from the former seed 10.1007/s12145-023-01218-x because it is within USGS 3DEP coverage; replacement seed 10.3390/rs15010169 supplies the earlier multi-dataset scientific design but its Portuguese project lidar is not the runtime asset.
current_task_binding.asset_provenance: The replacement seed constructs 0.1-1 m bare-earth DEMs from project UAV lidar. USGS/3DEP/1m is the ready catalog analogue for the same physical object and measurement semantics. Seed-study geography is not claimed as runtime coverage.

observation_identity_contract.source_lineage: airborne-lidar terrain mapping, including USGS 3DEP and project-specific airborne lidar
observation_identity_contract.non_material_variations: provider, format, reprojection or resampling derived from the qualifying fine-resolution lidar source
observation_identity_contract.material_mismatches: coarse elevation, photogrammetric DSM or non-lidar DEM without a qualifying airborne-lidar input

original_anchor_asset.asset_alias_policy: USGS 3DEP one-metre lidar-derived bare-earth elevation is admitted, as is project-specific airborne lidar DEM at one metre or finer; coarser 3DEP tiers, SRTM, ASTER GDEM, AW3D and other global DEMs are excluded.
original_anchor_asset.alias_policy_scope: This policy defines which product counts as the anchor, not whether a paper may also use other elevation products. A study that compares its lidar DEM against coarser DEMs is admissible as long as the metre-scale lidar surface is itself operationally processed.

anchor_repointed.reason: The seed derives its entire HAND surface from a 0.6 m airborne lidar DEM, not from SRTM. Its central claim is that metre-scale terrain can substitute for 2D hydrodynamic models in ungauged basins, so a 30 m anchor contradicts the research question rather than approximating it.
anchor_repointed.seed_evidence: Methods: 'we used a lidar DEM with a spatial resolution of 2 ft x 2 ft (0.6 m x 0.6 m) to generate the drainage network and watershed boundary', subdivided into seven sub-basins.
anchor_repointed.verified_against: Earth Engine catalog entry USGS/3DEP/1m (status ready, 1 m elevation band in metres, produced exclusively from high-resolution lidar source data, bare-earth surface)
anchor_repointed.residual_gap: The seed's own 0.6 m project lidar is finer than the 1 m 3DEP tier and is not published as an Earth Engine asset; 3DEP/1m is the closest available metre-scale lidar surface.

seed_replacement.reason: The replacement seed was first published online in 2022 and directly constructs 0.1 m, 0.25 m, 0.5 m and 1 m bare-earth DEMs from UAV airborne-lidar ground returns, while retaining a clear multi-dataset S2 design.
